subject: Appointment time correction
text: Thank you for checking in. I have just looked at the calendar again, and the entry I shared earlier was indeed misread. The appointment is not at the end of the week, but on Tuesday, at the later slot. I apologize for the confusion, especially since you were making plans around the original time. Nothing else has changed. The location, the length, and the purpose of the visit remain the same. I will send a short reminder once you confirm the corrected time. If the revised slot no longer suits you, please let me know today, so I can try to suggest another option. I appreciate your patience, and I would rather correct this promptly than have you turn up unnecessarily. A brief written reply is enough, and I will handle any rescheduling quietly, without delay for both of us.
